lede: Missouri carries the stronger underlying team rating — +7.2 against +4.9, a 2.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Missouri +1.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Florida winning 51% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is linebackers, where Missouri leads Florida by 91 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
